ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32327.htm.text: Adventurers' Guide: Are you weary from your long journey? Perhaps I can help strengthen you in your never-ending battle against the forces of evil. Even now, the monster attacks on this village grow stronger each day; it is only due to your tireless efforts that we have remained safe this long.
